prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: Spain gallery documentary master. Create a wide 16:9 low-light documentary photograph of Naveta des Tudons near Ciutadella, Menorca at 01:14 local time on 24 September 2026. Camera from the public visitor path southeast of the monument, low eye-level looking directly toward its flat entrance end and long rounded inverted-boat mass. Show one compact prehistoric funerary structure built from massive irregular dry-laid pale limestone blocks, with a very small low rectangular doorway in the end wall; open dry Menorcan field, sparse low scrub and simple earth path around it. Mostly clear moonless-looking deep navy-black sky, faint natural ambient blue light only, enough to read the form without artificial floodlighting. No visible lamps, glowing doorway, people, fences dominating, second monument, castle crenellations, giant doorway, moon, stars, Milky Way, text, logos or watermark. Honest long-exposure interpretation. Center monument for a complete 4:5 crop.
